_note: Only real, attributable authors belong here. A fabricated expert byline is worse than no byline: it is the exact signal E-E-A-T evaluation is designed to detect, and it is trivially falsifiable. Where no named individual can be attributed, an organisational author is honest and valid — schema.org accepts an Organization as `author`. To add a named technician or engineer, fill in `name`, `jobTitle` and real `credentials`, set `type` to "Person", and add a `sameAs` profile if one exists.

authors.name: AquaPure UAE Technical Team
authors.bio: The technicians who install, service and repair water treatment systems across the seven Emirates. Guidance here reflects what the team measures and repairs on UAE properties every day: point-of-use and point-of-entry systems, softeners, UV disinfection, and the failure modes that recur in tank-fed and tanker-fed supply.
expertise: Reverse osmosis system specification and commissioning
Point-of-entry filtration for villas and buildings
Ion-exchange softener sizing and regeneration setup
UV and contact disinfection for stored water
